statusLine.command: current_dir=$(basename "$(pwd)"); git_branch=$(git -c core.useReplaceRefs=false -c gc.autodetach=false branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$git_branch" ]; then printf '\033[1;31m➜\033[0m \033[1;32m\033[0m \033[36m%s\033[0m \033[1;34m(%s)\033[0m' "$current_dir" "$git_branch"; else printf '\033[1;31m➜\033[0m \033[1;32m\033[0m \033[36m%s\033[0m' "$current_dir"; fi
